facts.fact: iColo's spec sheet describes its Mombasa Two (MBA2) data center in Nyali, Mombasa, as a carrier-neutral facility offering quarter, half and full rack colocation with 2N UPS, 4,460 sqm and two 550 sqm data halls; it states no opening date, so as_of is the sheet's published date, 2022-07-19, and it is written as an operating offer.

note: No Tier rating stated; certification listed as PCI DSS and ISO27001 'ongoing'.
